commits.message:
A key and a press carry the frame they were heard on, and a step cuts the line at the row that frame drew (rich-control-codes-xh4n.bx4)

Review of #570: the focused-only framePainted push left a blurred field, a
render between paints and a cursor moved before a repaint reading a frame
other than the one on screen, behind a layout-identity guard. WidgetKeyEvent
and WidgetMouseEvent now hold the frame; the field keeps none.

Under logical, a step walks the stops the terminal shows on the whole painted line: the caret's end blank keeps a right-to-left row's level when a neighbour's text follows it (rich-control-codes-xh4n.bx4)

The end slot past the text never joins a Prepend character's cluster, so under visual order the caret after U+0600-U+0605 keeps its cell (rich-control-codes-xh4n.q87) (#569)

* The end slot past the text never joins a Prepend character's cluster, so under visual order the caret after U+0600-U+0605 keeps its cell (rich-control-codes-xh4n.q87)

* Cut the end slot only at its edges, so a glyph outside the BMP stays whole; pin Syriac Prepend and the drawn-cursor slot (review of #569)

* Every row ordered by cluster asks rowClusters, so seal's kitty reversal keeps the end slot apart from a Prepend character too (medium review of #569)

* The Syriac end slot under words order is an expected failure that goes green with qmw (second high review of #569)
